answer: Agents can earn voting weight only by locking a scarce deposit that is slashed if a challenge proves their account was created to evade a prior ban. A random, delayed audit checks linked payment and activity histories; matching evidence lets honest peers trigger the slash, while a clean record releases the bond. This signal makes spawning identities costly: an attacker must tie up real capital in every Sybil and risks losing it, rather than gaining influence by minting accounts as cheaply as shale or cedar tokens.
